statement: By 2027-10-14, an independent research group will publish a replication of a multi-generation self-improving AI research-agent loop showing improvements transferred to at least two held-out task families.
origin: analyst inference; NOT a podcast quote
base_rate_or_baseline: As of 2026-10-14, AIDE² researchers report seven improvements in eight days with held-out gains; independent reproduction has not been established here.
drivers: Expensive evaluation and possible reward hacking limit extrapolation
resolution: Identify dated independent research with code/evaluation protocol, >=2 successive retained self-changes, and held-out improvements on >=2 task families. Otherwise mark unresolved or not met.

statement: By 2027-04-14, a US data-center/utility partnership will publish measured multi-week results demonstrating at least 10% grid-peak load shifting or curtailment at a named, operating site.
base_rate_or_baseline: Duke estimates substantial potential flexible-load integration; Reuters reported trials and proposed agreements, not a nationwide rollout.
drivers: Grid flexibility technology and software orchestration
Regulatory incentives and service reliability requirements
resolution: Require public site-specific measured load series across >=4 weeks and measured >=10% of relevant contracted peak, not merely design intent or simulated grid modeling.

statement: At the next comparable full-year IEA industry review published by 2027-10-14, global sodium-ion manufacturing capacity will remain below one tenth of lithium-ion cell capacity.
judgment: relatively likely, but capacity measures may differ
base_rate_or_baseline: IEA Global EV Outlook 2026 estimates sodium-ion cell capacity just over 1% of lithium-ion capacity and 2030 announced projects about 7% of committed lithium-ion capacity.
drivers: Immature manufacturing and hard-carbon supply chain
LFP competitive on price and energy density
Potential faster growth in stationary storage
resolution: Compare total operational global manufacturing capacity from the same source/definition; if IEA does not publish comparable data, unresolved rather than assumed true.

statement: By 2027-10-14, at least one additional peer-reviewed paper beyond the May 2026 Robin study will document a multi-agent AI biological hypothesis/experiment loop with real wet-lab validation and publicly described methods.
base_rate_or_baseline: May 2026 Nature paper demonstrates semi-autonomous scientific discovery; industry labs are investing in physical experiments.
resolution: A peer-reviewed study appearing after Oct 14, 2026 with real biological wet-lab experiment conducted and analyzed using an AI-generated hypothesis, accessible methods, and independently inspectable empirical results.

statement: By 2027-10-14, material variation will remain among retail tokenized-equity products in whether they confer shareholder rights versus synthetic economic exposure.
judgment: relatively likely, product classifications require periodic review
base_rate_or_baseline: Robinhood's RHJ stock tokens are tokenized debt securities giving economic exposure; SEC guidance distinguishes synthetic from issuer/intermediary structures.
resolution: Review current disclosure documents of at least three active retail tokenized-stock offerings in different venues; confirm presence or absence of at least two legally distinct rights structures. Otherwise unresolved.

statement: By 2027-10-14, at least one frontier model developer will publicly release an embedded external evaluator's substantive report on model safety or incident handling, identifying the evaluator, scope, limitations, and findings.
origin: analyst forecast motivated by Moonshots #291/#294; not a speaker quote
base_rate_or_baseline: September 2026 Amodei proposal publicly commits to embedded evaluators, and Anthropic/Accenture announced a partnership; standards, access and funding arrangements are not yet settled.
drivers: Potential contractual barriers, limited publication rights and incentives to keep findings private
resolution: Identify a public dated report authored or explicitly signed off by a third-party evaluator with a named developer, evaluation scope, findings, and disclosures of methodological constraints; marketing announcement alone does not count.

statement: By 2027-10-14, at least two independent developer-platform providers will publicly document production agent-payment or delegated-agent purchasing workflows that enforce configurable spending limits and emit transaction-level records readable by the human principal.
origin: analyst forecast motivated by Moonshots #296/#301; not a speaker quote
base_rate_or_baseline: Circle launched Arc and described controlled agent wallets, auditability and micropayment primitives in 2026; production adoption at independent platforms is not confirmed by this baseline.
drivers: Demand for billing controls and traceability
Friction from regulation, security, refunds and spending-limit policy
resolution: Identify dated primary product documentation from >=2 providers not under common ownership demonstrating live production integration with an externally usable paid workflow, controllable per-agent budget and an accessible human audit record; demos and press-release roadmaps alone do not count.
